insights.creative: The guide offer framed as a fight (you are in a war and only one side knows the rules) with the list of mistakes taxpayers make is carrying the account. The softer revised copy costs more per lead so far. Next we will test a short video walking through those common mistakes.
insights.doing: 86 people requested the free IRS guide this week at $2.91 each, compared with 93 at $2.56 the week before, on $249.89 of spend. Both numbers sit inside the range the account has held for the past two months.
insights.look_into: The report sees only Meta's lead count, so it cannot show how many of the 86 booked a call or became clients. We recommend sharing that count so it can be tracked here. Nothing in the account's change history this week looks out of place.
insights.next: A new ad with revised copy started on Sep 18 and brought 6 leads on $35.24, a higher cost per lead than the main ad so far. Next we will give it a full week, then keep whichever ad delivers leads at the lower cost, and hold the budget steady.
